productDetail.documentsDesc: Free one-click download: COA, TDS, MSDS, REACH registration, HALAL/KOSHER/FSSC22000
productDetail.sampleDesc: We provide free 10g-50g test samples for cosmetic raw materials. Customers only bear international DHL freight. All courier cost will be fully deducted from your first bulk order.
productDetail.faq1q: How many days sample delivery to India/SEA?
productDetail.faq1a: DHL delivery 4-6 working days, door to door.
productDetail.faq2q: Can you provide full customs clearance documents for India import?
productDetail.faq2a: Yes, we supply commercial invoice, CO, SGS test report, origin statement as customs demand.
productDetail.faq3a: In-stock goods support 1kg trial order; bulk standard package 20kg/25kg drum/bag.
productDetail.faq4q: Are your goods stable batch with consistent purity?
productDetail.faq4a: Independent laboratory full inspection for every batch, complete test record provided.
